name: k3s
readme_excerpt: K3s - Lightweight Kubernetes Lightweight Kubernetes. Production ready, easy to install, half the memory, all in a binary less than 100 MB. Great for: Edge IoT CI Development ARM Embedding k8s Situations where a PhD in k8s clusterology is infeasible What is this? K3s is a fully conformant production-ready Kubernetes distribution with the following changes: 1. It is packaged as a single binary. 1. It adds support for sqlite3 as the default storage backend.
